shadows.name: evidence-panel
shadows.purpose: Separates the Fourier matrix from surrounding teaching copy.

shadows.name: measurement-stage
shadows.purpose: Separates the live spectrum from the bench.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-emphasis action in a local control group.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 15px; border: 1px solid #d8ff52; border-radius: 12px; background: #d8ff52; color: #171d00; font: 700 16px sans-serif; transition: transform 160ms ease-out, background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: #e4ff84; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d8ff52; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A lower-emphasis transport or utility action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 15px; border: 1px solid #555b4a; border-radius: 12px; background: #171a14; color: #f1f2ea; font: 600 16px sans-serif; transition: transform 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: #f1f2ea; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d8ff52; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Mode Navigation
components.description: Persistent segmented switching between operating and teaching modes.
components.css: .ds-mode-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; width: max-content; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid #34382d; border-radius: 14px; background: #10120e; } .ds-mode-nav a { min-width: 108px; padding: 9px 16px; border-radius: 10px; color: #adb2a4; font: 700 16px sans-serif; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; } .ds-mode-nav .ds-active { background: #d8ff52; color: #171d00; } .ds-mode-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d8ff52; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Frequency Choice
components.description: A compact selectable tone with a measurement-first label.
components.css: .ds-frequency-choice { display: grid; min-width: 150px; min-height: 88px; align-content: space-between; padding: 13px; border: 1px solid #ff5b45; border-radius: 12px; background: #2c1a16; color: #f1f2ea; text-align: left; } .ds-frequency-choice strong { font: 700 14px monospace; } .ds-frequency-choice small { color: #adb2a4; } .ds-frequency-choice:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d8ff52; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Band Mapping Strip
components.description: The canonical direct mapping from sound range to LED channel.
components.html: Red is bassGreen is midsBlue is treble
components.css: .ds-band-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 4px; background: #090a08; color: #0c0d09; font: 700 22px 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; } .ds-band-strip span { padding: 24px; } .ds-band-strip span:nth-child(1) { background: #ff5b45; } .ds-band-strip span:nth-child(2) { background: #91e75c; } .ds-band-strip span:nth-child(3) { background: #5cbcff; }

narrative.overview: The interface feels like a carefully labelled instrument brought into a lecture: dark enough to keep waveforms and equations dominant, direct enough to operate live, and vivid only where colour carries meaning.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black bench surfaces with thin etched dividers.
Signal yellow reserved for active state and the main action.
Red, green, and blue preserve their bass, mids, and treble meanings.
Oversized condensed headings paired with quiet technical labels.

rules.name: Frequency Colour Rule
rules.body: Red means bass, green means mids, and blue means treble everywhere; mixed hues are reserved for simultaneous bands.

rules.name: Rare Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal yellow identifies the current action or mathematical focus, not general decoration.

rules.name: Equation Rule
rules.body: Mathematical variables, operators, vectors, matrices, and complexity expressions use KaTeX; prose remains prose.

rules.name: Flat Bench Rule
rules.body: Do not add card shadows to ordinary controls or teaching copy; depth is reserved for the two primary evidence surfaces.

dos: State the red/bass, green/mids, and blue/treble mapping beside both operation and teaching content.
Keep live ESP32 evidence visibly distinct from generated browser analysis.
Use strong scale contrast between page claims, explanations, and instrument labels.
Preserve 44px control targets, visible focus, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Use signal yellow as ambient decoration or a fourth frequency band.
Turn every teaching step into a floating card.
Use gradients, faux hardware textures, or decorative scientific imagery.
Show mathematical notation as improvised plain-text symbols when KaTeX can express it.
